# s407 — The implementer brief runs a defect self-check before review

Every brief in `slicer ai relay` and `slicer ai relay-orchestrator` has the implementer check its own diff before each review, fix rounds included, for concurrency and handle lifetime, docs updated with the code, and a test that fails when the new wiring is removed, fix what it finds, and give the result in its report; the existing re-anchor-at-start rule is unchanged and not restated.

**Findings:**  · **Size:** S · **Tree:** ai

**Not in this slice:** re-anchoring itself (already in the Roles paragraph for the implementer and in Every brief), recording re-anchored references with `slicer edit` as ork's implementer does, a self-check for any other role, a daemon-lifecycle category (slicer's contract names no daemon; a project adds its own categories through its environment lines), and the contract bump (s424 bumps to v11 once for all of v1.17).

## Why

Line anchors in slice specs drift as other slices land; re-anchoring at spec time was repeated per slice and wasted. That half has already landed: the implementer's Roles paragraph says "at start the implementer re-anchors them against the code in the worktree", and Every brief says "The implementer brief says cited line numbers may have moved and to re-anchor them at start" (pinned by `test_RelayRoles_Implementer_ReAnchorsLineReferencesLateAtStart` and `test_RelayEveryBrief_OwnerDecisionsSpecCheckAndReAnchor_Carried`). This slice adds only the self-check.

The review FAIL notes in ork's run fell into a few categories: races and handle lifetime (S15, S25, S36, S52), daemon lifecycle (S13, S17, S46), wiring that never reached its caller (S47), and docs out of step with the code (S47, S48, S49). ork's S115 added a Self-check section to its implementer prompt (`../ork/internal/roles/prompts/implementer.md`): review the diff for concurrency and handle lifetime, confirm docs updated with the code describe the behaviour that ships, confirm a test fails when the wiring is removed using the mutation-check evidence, fix and rerun before reporting. ork's report has no self-check part; here the result goes in the implementer's report so the reviewer sees what was checked (default accepted by the owner 2026-10-30).

Proposed wording for Every brief, after the re-anchor sentence (default accepted by the owner 2026-10-30): "Before each review, fix rounds included, the implementer checks its own diff for concurrency and handle lifetime (locks, files and processes it opens are released on every path), for docs that describe the changed behaviour updated in the same diff, and for a test that fails when the new wiring is removed (a mutation that disconnects the call site), and fixes what it finds." The report sentence becomes: "The report is a diff stat, red lines, test counts, a mutation table, the implementer's self-check (each of the three: what it checked, or `n/a`) and deviations."

Owner decision 2026-10-30: every v1.17 rule change lands at v10 text and s424 bumps to v11 once, last.
